title: cargo run
description: Runs a binary of a crate with cargo run, in the root folder of the Cargo workspace.

features.description: Features to activate, passed as --features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run and doc.

allFeatures.description: Activate all features, passed as --all-features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run and doc.

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default features, passed as --no-default-features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run and doc.

profile.description: The Cargo profile to build with, passed as --profile. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run and doc.

targetTriple.description: The platform triple to build for, passed as --target. Taken by build, check, lint, bench, run and doc; test runs on the host triple only.

bin.description: The binary to run, passed as --bin, for a crate with several binaries and no default-run.

pluginVersion.description: The plugin's version, which the plugin sets for the cache key. Not meant to be set by hand.
